articles.title: AI is reshaping banking jobs – but its ability to drive profits remains unclear
articles.summary: Banks' third-quarter results have brought their use of artificial intelligence into sharper focus, as lenders automate routine work, reshape hiring and test whether productivity gains can translate into revenue growth. This earnings season, Barclays unveiled layoffs in certain functions where AI is being deployed; while UniCredit and Santander said technology was freeing employees for higher-value work and improving processes.

articles.title: China’s slowdown deepens in October as industrial output, retail sales, investment miss estimates
articles.summary: China's economic slowdown worsened in October with retail sales, investment and industrial output all missing economists' estimates, as analysts warn a growing reliance on external demand leaves growth more exposed to shocks abroad. Growth in the world's second-largest economy bounced off three-year lows in the third quarter, expanding 4.5% from a year earlier.

articles.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in third-quarter as elevated energy costs bite
articles.summary: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracted in the third quarter, shrinking at an annualized 0.1% compared to the previous quarter, as elevated energy prices weighed on consumption and net exports. A Reuters poll of economists had estimated the economy to grow at 0.3% in the three months to September, while GDP had expanded at 1.4% in the previous quarter.
